fixtures.name: map_key_text_undo_delete
fixtures.description: Undo the delete of a map key holding a Y.Text restores the text content.

fixtures.name: array_nested_map_children_undo_delete
fixtures.description: Undo the delete of an array element holding a Y.Map restores its entries, including a nested Y.Text.

fixtures.name: nested_in_nested_undo_delete
fixtures.description: Undo the delete of a map that holds a map that holds a Y.Text and a Y.Array.

fixtures.name: map_key_text_undo_redo_undo
fixtures.description: Undo, redo, then undo again the delete of a map key holding a Y.Text.

fixtures.name: map_key_text_full_unwind
fixtures.description: After undo/redo/undo of the delete, undoing the original set removes the twice-restored text.

fixtures.name: nested_edit_merged_undo
fixtures.description: A nested map edit merged between two captured pushes is undone with them, restoring the overwritten value.

fixtures.name: fresh_doc_merged_pushes_undo
fixtures.description: Two merged pushes on a fresh doc are both undone.

fixtures.name: insert_then_delete_merged_undo
fixtures.description: An element inserted and deleted within one capture interval stays deleted on undo.

fixtures.name: edit_after_undo_starts_new_item
fixtures.description: An edit right after an undo is not merged into the next-older stack item (undo stops capturing).

fixtures.name: merged_run_undo_delete_then_remote_insert
fixtures.description: Two pushes Yjs holds as one struct are restored as one item, so a concurrent insert lands after both.

fixtures.name: merged_run_redo_then_remote_insert
fixtures.description: Redoing two merged pushes re-inserts them as one item ahead of a concurrent insert.

fixtures.name: map_restore_follows_delete_order
fixtures.description: Restored values sharing a key are replayed in first-delete order, so the last-deleted client wins.

fixtures.name: nested_key_restored_over_collected_remote_set
fixtures.description: A remote set inside a map deleted here reaches us collected; undoing the delete restores the old value.

fixtures.name: collected_overwritten_remote_value_blocks_restore
fixtures.description: A remote value collected because a later remote value overwrote it still blocks undo restoring an older value under its key.

fixtures.name: collected_remote_delete_in_live_map_blocks_restore
fixtures.description: A remote set-then-delete of a key in a live map is a remote edit undo must not overwrite, though its value was collected.

fixtures.name: merged_run_partial_undo_after_restore
fixtures.description: Undoing one half of a restored merged run deletes only that half of its copy.

fixtures.name: unmerged_neighbours_restore_separately
fixtures.description: Adjacent same-client items with different right origins are separate structs in Yjs and are restored separately.
